columns.name: waterway_flag
columns.reason: Static site attribute of the crossing, fixed in the inventory long before any inspection.

columns.name: deck_condition_state
columns.reason: The deck condition rating assigned in this evaluation is itself the quantity whose drop defines a downgrade.

columns.name: permit_class
columns.reason: Administrative overweight-permit designation carried on the route record beforehand.

columns.name: wetland_flag
columns.reason: Fixed environmental site attribute recorded in the inventory.

columns.name: superstructure_condition_state
columns.reason: Component rating assigned in the same evaluation, and a change in it is what constitutes the downgrade.

columns.name: county_code
columns.reason: Static geographic identifier.

columns.name: paint_system
columns.reason: Recorded coating system of the structure, known from prior records.

columns.name: owner_agency
columns.reason: Stable ownership attribute of the asset.

columns.name: nbi_submission_batch
columns.reason: The submission batch carries the finalized inspection record, so it is assigned only after the rating decision exists.

columns.name: material_type
columns.reason: As-built structural material, fixed for the life of the bridge.

columns.name: photo_vendor
columns.reason: Vendor engaged when the inspection is arranged, not a product of the rating outcome.

columns.name: utility_attachment
columns.reason: Physical inventory attribute of what is attached to the structure.

columns.name: chloride_survey_index
columns.reason: Standing chloride test result on file; predictive of deterioration but not an input to the rating decision.

columns.name: traffic_control_plan
columns.reason: Set during inspection planning, before any findings are made.

columns.name: span_length_m
columns.reason: As-built geometry, fixed in the inventory.

columns.name: route_class
columns.reason: Static roadway classification of the carried route.

columns.name: historic_flag
columns.reason: Long-standing designation attribute of the structure.

columns.name: drone_survey_flag
columns.reason: Inspection method chosen when the visit is planned, ahead of the rating decision.

columns.name: bearing_type
columns.reason: As-built component type recorded in the inventory.

columns.name: design_code
columns.reason: Design standard used at construction, fixed historically.

columns.name: utility_owner
columns.reason: Static record of who owns the attached utilities.

columns.name: district
columns.reason: Stable administrative region of the asset.

columns.name: load_posting_tonnes
columns.reason: Posted limit on file follows from the load rating already in the inventory rather than from the condition decision.

columns.name: railing_type
columns.reason: As-built component type in the inventory record.

columns.name: followup_ndt_defect_index
columns.reason: Follow-up nondestructive testing is ordered in response to the inspection finding, so it postdates and encodes the downgrade rationale.

columns.name: adt_heavy_vehicles
columns.reason: Traffic loading statistic already on file for the route.

columns.name: joint_type
columns.reason: As-built component type recorded in the inventory.

columns.name: access_equipment
columns.reason: Equipment arranged for reaching the structure, decided before findings are recorded.

columns.name: funding_program
columns.reason: Program the asset is administered under, established before the inspection cycle.

columns.name: seismic_zone
columns.reason: Fixed hazard classification of the site.

columns.name: substructure_condition_state
columns.reason: Component rating assigned in the same evaluation and used to determine whether the rating was downgraded.

columns.name: load_rating_method
columns.reason: Methodology recorded with the existing load rating, independent of the condition outcome.

columns.name: age_years
columns.reason: Computable from the build year at any prediction time.

columns.name: detour_designation
columns.reason: Planned detour routing recorded as an inventory item for the crossing.

columns.name: consultant_firm
columns.reason: Firm contracted before the inspection is carried out.

columns.name: detour_length_km
columns.reason: Standard inventory item measuring the bypass route length.

columns.name: inspection_team
columns.reason: Crew assigned at scheduling, prior to any rating decision.

columns.name: environmental_class
columns.reason: Exposure classification of the site held in the inventory.

columns.name: scour_class
columns.reason: Standing scour evaluation code on the record, separate from the condition ratings that define the downgrade.

columns.name: deicing_applications
columns.reason: Maintenance history accumulated and logged before the prediction point.
